top_fix: When the headline's scope or statistic differs from what was asked (all home types instead of condos, median instead of average), say so in the headline label, e.g. 'Not condo-only: all-types median', not only in the small print and the caveats at the bottom.
second_fix: Don't put an unusable figure like '$1K (rounded)/sqft' in the cross-check or conflict tables as a real value; show it as 'not published exactly', and drop the condo YoY % and median sale price rows, which point to a condo $/sqft figure the page never gives.
template_change_suggested: Add required fields to the metric template: 'statistic_asked' vs 'statistic_shown' and 'scope_asked' vs 'scope_shown'. Show a mismatch badge next to the big number whenever they differ. Require cross_check values to be numeric, or mark them 'unavailable' with a reason, and don't render them as figures.
